{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter to completed orders only
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check the revenue column for thousands separators
print(df_completed['revenue'].str.contains(r',', na=False).sum())

# Convert revenue to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
df_completed['revenue_numeric'] = pd.to_numeric(df_completed['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any parsing errors
print(df_completed['revenue_numeric'].isna().sum())

# Check for the six QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
print(df_completed['revenue_numeric'].value_counts().get(999999.99, 0))

# Count how many rows have revenue_numeric == 999999.99
qa_rows = df_completed[df_completed['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99]
print(len(qa_rows))

# Display the first few of these QA rows
print(qa_rows.head())"}
